digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Wednesday, October 28 has nine live meetings, four calendar collisions, three carried-over tasks, and three urgent priorities. Use the 10:30 AM Amazon Connect standup to validate the deployed Lambda voicemail fix and set the Denver go/no-go evidence; then address the fresh critical Supabase RLS warning and translate leadership's new MHE requirement into an owned rollout plan. Protect the noon work block for those decisions before the afternoon portfolio sequence. The completion state is current through Tuesday morning.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect recovery decision
items.detail: The Lambda voicemail fix is deployed and ready to test. Use the 10:30 AM standup to confirm full regression results, whether Conversation Analytics still works, whether the workaround remains necessary, and what evidence will govern Denver's go/no-go decision. Close the remaining user, skills, queue, deployment, and deadline owners in the same decision record.

items.label: Complete the LeadUp growth-mindset follow-up survey
items.detail: The Module 3 follow-up survey remains open. Use a short low-context window today or assign a firm completion time.

items.label: Confirm the Cross-Firm Lead Intake project name
items.detail: Confirm whether Mar's new project is the item labeled Cross-Firm Lead Intake so the leadership deck and project records stay consistent.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Choose between Thiago's 1:1 and the Amazon standup
items.detail: The two meetings overlap. Prioritize or delegate Amazon recovery coverage so the deployed Lambda fix, analytics behavior, and Denver readiness receive a clear decision.

items.label: Noon - Protect the work block
items.detail: Use the hour to document the Amazon decision, route the Supabase security issue, and assign the MHE rollout work before the afternoon sequence begins.

items.label: 1:30 PM to 3:00 PM - BD review flows into the team meeting
items.detail: The 2:00 PM EPMO Team Meeting features Data Engineering, while Astrid's 2:30 PM 1:1 lands inside it. Move or delegate the 1:1 and keep portfolio decisions concise.

items.label: 3:30 PM to 4:30 PM - Resolve two double-booked blocks
items.detail: Legal Portfolio Review conflicts with Laura's 1:1 at 3:30 PM, and the CoE touchpoint conflicts with weekly-meeting focus time at 4:00 PM. Decide which meetings need Jean and which can move or proceed with delegated coverage.

items.label: 4:30 PM - Jean and Sara 1:1
items.detail: Use the final meeting to close unresolved intake-governance, staffing, and portfolio decisions from the day.

items.label: Remediate the critical Supabase RLS warning
items.detail: Supabase reports that a public table in project niqzkombzncxxihhulqq remains readable, editable, and deletable because Row-Level Security is disabled. Verify the affected table in the Security Advisor, enable the intended protections, and confirm the alert clears.

items.label: Turn the MHE requirement into an owned rollout
items.detail: Leadership wants mental health evaluations presented as a standard client requirement, prior declines re-approached with clear legal guidance, and provider coverage expanded beyond Florida and Texas. Assign owners for intake scripts, cost disclosure, re-offer criteria, provider-state coverage, task-set changes, and the rollout date.

items.label: Reset the Quality intake path with Sara
items.detail: Two Quality initiatives were moved to not viable after arriving without Operations prioritization or clear project-lead alignment. Prepare Friday's follow-up with Sara and Licelot so future gaps are evaluated within the larger project context before a new intake is submitted.

items.label: Jhara is out through November 2
items.detail: Her calendar remains blocked through the start of November 3. Keep time-sensitive portfolio work with available owners.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect daily standup
items.detail: Bring the test evidence and unresolved Denver go/no-go criteria forward if today's validation does not fully close the recovery decision.

items.label: 11:30 AM to 1:00 PM - Armando 1:1 followed by protected work time
items.detail: Use the open hour after the 1:1 to finish any owners or documentation created by today's security, MHE, and portfolio decisions before the 1:30 PM BCP and Incident Response meeting.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Tudo Bem weekly meeting
items.detail: Carry in only the roadblocks and decisions that need the full team's coordination.
